left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Age of both genders from 18 to 75 years
  -  ASA physiological status I-III
  -  Participation in abdominal, [OR]  orthopedic, [OR]  laparoscopical, [OR]  gynecological  [OR] and urological interventions

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patient rejection
  -  History of chronic opioid intake
  -  History of renal, [OR]  hepatic  [OR] or psychiatric disorders
  -  Heart failure,
  -  Organ transplant history,
  -  Lidocaine allergy
  -  Family history of malignant hyperthermia
